spotlight.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
spotlight.description: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

latest.title: Cinemax Android App
latest.description: Cinemax Android অ্যাপ এখন সম্পূর্ণ নতুন রূপে — নতুন ডিজাইন, বাংলা সাবটাইটেল আর ডায়নামিক আইল্যান্ড প্লেয়ার। ওয়েবের পাশাপাশি এখন মোবাইলেও উপভোগ করুন। পুরোনো ভার্সন থাকলে আপডেট করে নিন। লগইন করতে Cinemax অ্যাকাউন্ট লাগবে।

latest.title: Singh vs Kaur 2
latest.description: Nehal, son of a martyred soldier, plans to uplift his village through fish farming. When Jasneet vanishes with their savings, he is branded a fraud and pursues her. He learns a drug gang forced her to act by kidnapping her brother. Choosing compassion over revenge, Nehal joins Jasneet and Tari to rescue him, defeat the gang and recover the money, restoring his father's honour.

latest.title: The Skin Crawler Murders
latest.description: A detective investigating ritualistic murders uncovers a taxidermist serial killer who abducts women and harvests their body parts in a twisted experiment.

latest.title: Way of the Warrior Kid
latest.description: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

latest.title: The Swallowed
latest.description: In Sulawesi, Indonesia, a mother of six is swallowed by a giant python. Beyond the attacks, The Swallowed explores the complex relationship between humans, wildlife and the natural world, and how our actions shape one another's lives.

latest.title: The Slightest Touch
latest.description: Emma Fogarty lives with Epidermolysis Bullosa, a rare and extremely painful genetic condition that leaves her skin so fragile it blisters and tears at the slightest touch. As she turns 40, the age doctors predicted she would never reach, she takes up an offer from her long-time friend, Colin Farrell, to complete the Dublin Marathon together, with Farrell pushing her wheelchair for the final few miles.

latest.title: Garividi Lakshmi
latest.description: A gifted folk singer from North Andhra rises to fame through her captivating voice and Burra Katha performances, only to mysteriously disappear at the height of her popularity. Years later, a man sets out to unravel the mystery. What happened to Garividi Lakshmi?

latest.title: Koffee with Karan
latest.description: Koffee with Karan is an Indian talk show hosted by filmmaker and television personality Karan Johar and produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, the digital content division of Johar's production company Dharma Productions

latest.title: Bigg Boss
latest.description: Your ‘Host and Dost’ Salman Khan is back! Brace for another high-octane season of the greatest reality show, serving entertainment and drama—all unfiltered!

latest.title: The Mosquito Bowl
latest.description: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

latest.title: Blade Runner 2099
latest.description: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

latest.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
latest.description: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power

latest.title: Delhi 2021
latest.description: The second wave of the deadly coronavirus pandemic is raging in the Delhi NCR region. In the midst of this horror, the lives of disparate individuals intertwine, revealing the intricate web of humanity's struggle and strength.

latest.title: Breeder
latest.description: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

latest.title: Rob Lowe: The Outsider
latest.description: Traces Lowe's career from his breakout roles in “The Outsiders” and “St. Elmo’s Fire” to his Emmy-nominated performance on “The West Wing” and how he maintained his Hollywood career.

latest.title: The Last Song You Left Behind
latest.description: Haruto Mizushima secretly loves writing poetry. One day, his classmate Ayane Toosaka discovers his hidden hobby. Ayane has developmental dyslexia, which makes reading and writing extremely difficult for her, yet she possesses remarkable talent in singing and composing music. At Ayane's request, Haruto begins writing lyrics for her music. As they spend time creating songs together, they gradually develop feelings for each other. Their talents both clash and draw them closer, making them cherish one another even more—this is a love story spanning ten years that will move you to tears.

latest.title: Wicker
latest.description: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

latest.title: You Can See Everything
latest.description: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

latest.title: London Has Fallen
latest.description: In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning discovers a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.

latest.title: Angel Has Fallen
latest.description: After a treacherous attack, Secret Service agent Mike Banning is charged with attempting to assassinate President Trumbull. Chased by his own colleagues and the FBI, Banning begins a race against the clock to clear his name.

latest.title: The Notebook
latest.description: An epic love story centered around an older man who reads aloud to a woman with Alzheimer's. From a faded notebook, the old man's words bring to life the story about a couple who is separated by World War II, and is then passionately reunited, seven years later, after they have taken different paths.

latest.title: Janata Bar
latest.description: Mothers, children, sisters, and ordinary revolutionaries frequently make huge personal sacrifices in the fight for the right to live equally under the law. 'Janata Bar' is the story of one such woman who fought for justice.

latest.title: Ice Cream Man
latest.description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

latest.title: Cloud Girl
latest.description: The adventures of a young girl named Providence, who is entrusted with a magic quill that makes everything she writes come true. Faced with this incredible power, she has to choose between living her dreams and saving the world.

latest.title: Fleak
latest.description: When 12-year-old Lauri tries too hard to get his older siblings’ attention he falls badly and loses his ability to walk. Now Lauri is stuck at home, lonelier than he ever was. Just then a helpful furry creature from another dimension appears and takes him on a fantasy adventure. In the other dimension Lauri trades his shadow for being able to walk again, but the shadow becomes a goofy, all-eating monster who follows Lauri back to his world. To beat the monster Lauri needs to team up with his siblings and give up his ability to walk. However, Lauri is now determined to learn to walk again and he has his siblings beside him - and that’s what really matters.

latest.title: Fjord
latest.description: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbet's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

latest.title: Jim Queen
latest.description: When Heterosis, a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight, sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six-packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

latest.title: Lottie Dottie Chicken: The Movie
latest.description: When a clumsy stork mixed up the eggs during delivery, Lottie Dottie Chicken's first egg ends up in the nest of a fearsome hawk in the mountains.

latest.title: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing
latest.description: Influencer Chiara Ferragni opens up for the first time on the charity scandal that rocked her career and sparked the end of her high-profile marriage.

latest.title: Until We Meet Again
latest.description: After failing to land a job, Shimizu Misora stumbles into an internship at funeral company Bando Kaikan and trains under the strict but compassionate Urushibara Reiji. As she learns to care for the bereaved, her discouragement turns into admiration, and a new sense of purpose.

latest.title: Kaali Kheti
latest.description: A story of inheritance land, legacy, trauma and the cost of trying to bury the past to grow the future.
